omar: Heads-up — saw a ~2.3x p50 latency spike on mixtral-mistral combo when FlashAttention was selected for a Qwen model with non-8-multiple head dim (qwen-10h, head_dim=10). Dumping kernel select logs and a tiny repro below. anyone seen this?

alisa: Oof. Do you have seq len / batch details? Could be RoPE scaling hitting a special mask path.

omar: repro: model=qwen-10h variant=mixtral-compat, batch=8, seq=512, head_dim=10, rope_scale=0.98. Kernel logs:
```
[INFO] kernel_selector: trying FlashAttention kernel: flash_attn_v2 (requires head_dim % 8 == 0)
[WARN] kernel_selector: head_dim % 8 != 0 -> using padded kernel path
[ERROR] triton_compiler: failed to compile flash_triton_kernel: warp_mask_mismatch (RoPE scaling mismatch)
[INFO] kernel_selector: falling back to SDPA kernel (sdpa_cu)
```
latency: p50 baseline(soft-fallover to sdpa)=38ms, observed=92ms after attempted Flash path + fallback.

mike: Looks like Triton compile failing at runtime triggers the expensive fallback and extra memcopies. SDPA fallback itself is fine but we've seen masking-induced extra copies when RoPE scale != 1. Can you paste the perf profile?

omar: profiler snippet (top rows):
```
CPU  40% - kernel_router (serialize fallback decision)
GPU  60% - sdpa_cu: extra buffer alloc + memcpy (seq_pad to 16)
GPU  20% - triton_compile_wait (spiky)
```
Also config used: 
```json
{"KV_PREFETCH": false, "REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFER": "flash,triton,sdpa", "AUTO_PAD_HEADS": false}
```

kai: Quick notes: FlashAttention expects head dims aligned to 8/16 for its fastest kernels. For odd head dims we route to a padded/triton path that can hit compile-time edgecases. With non-1 RoPE scaling we sometimes take a masked warp that Triton miscompiles -> runtime compile fail -> sdpa fallback. The fallback path does extra zero-pad memcpy which kills latency.
If you enable KV prefetch it reduces fragmentation in KV cache and avoids a few extra memcpys. Try `REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=1` and also `REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFER=sdpa,flash` to force SDPA first for odd heads.

omar: tried `REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=1` and forcing SDPA first. p50 returns to ~40ms (nice) but host CPU rose by ~12% due to prefetch threads. KV fragmentation metric dropped (kv_frag_ratio 0.42 -> 0.07). No model quality regressions observed. Profiling snippet after change: 
```
GPU  85% - sdpa_cu (no extra memcpys)
CPU  25% - kv_prefetch_worker
```

jen: We should add a unit/integration test that exercises head_dim %8 !=0 + rope_scale !=1 to prevent this regressing. Filed PERF-1123 and added a short repro in the ticket.

perf-bot: New benchmark uploaded: run_id=2026-03-16-0543. Summary: qwen-10h (head_dim=10) p50 with flash+triton enabled=92ms -> with SDPA-first + KV_PREFETCH=1 = 41ms. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/2026-03-16-0543/

tao: Proposal: short-term: route odd head dims to the SDPA-optimized path explicitly (bypass Triton) until we get a safe Triton compile for the masked warp. Add a canary flag `REDWOOD_KERNEL_ROUTE=sdpa-oddheads` and a rollout to 1% of dedicated. Long-term: upstream a fix/workaround to Triton and add padded-kernel correctness tests. I'll open a PR for the canary.

omar: OK, will run canary on dedicated and report results. attaching the tiny repro script (seq=512, batch=8) to the PERF-1123 ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
